title: Daily Combo
intro: A risk-adjusted combination from today's strongest AI predictions. Probabilities are model estimates; the combined probability is the product of the match probabilities.

edgeHint: Edge = probability × odds − 1. If negative, the odds are low relative to the model's probability.

historyNone: No evaluated matches yet for this probability band.
